title: Electronic Structure of Ruddlesden-Popper Faults in Perovskite Oxide Thin Films
content: Defect engineering provides an exciting platform to harness the unique properties of atomic scale defects absent in the parent structure [1-6]. Extended 1D or 2D defects are particularly promising as they extend across the entire crystal in one or two directions, while being atomically small in the others. In this study, we use first-principles density functional theory (DFT) and analytical STEM to evaluate the structure and electronic properties of Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) faults in perovskite oxide thin films.
